info.title: Cyber Web Collector analyst API
info.description: Loopback-only analyst API (reach it through an SSH tunnel). Session cookie plus X-CSRF-Token on every mutation; MFA and case-membership authorisation. Objects outside your cases return 404. Generated from the live route table by `npm run openapi`.
